title: Kehke sab ya imam rote hai
body:
Kehke sab ya imam rote hai
sab ali ke ghulaam rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj dunya se jaa rahe hai ali
hai qaza ka payaam rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sar se moula ke qoon behta hai
sun ke sab qaaso aam rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hogaya sar shigaafta dekho
rone ka hai maqaam rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sar pe moula ke haaye tegh lagi
peet kar sar ghulaam rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
roza khola nahi kisi ne bhi
bhooke pyaase tamaam rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai ali bistare shahaadat par
ghar me sab sub'ho shaam rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
chain ek pal nahi hai moula ko
hoke be kal imaam rote hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj ke din ali shaheed hue
aaj gyaara imam rote hai
